honesty_notes: The frozen migration map's rows still read rust_identity_verified=false and were deliberately NOT flipped in place. Three independent freezes make the in-map flip an owner-authorization matter, not an E2 action: (1) schemas/semantic-id-migration-map-1.0.0.schema.json pins rust_identity_verified to const false (and TestSchemaRefusesVerifiedRustIdentity pins that); (2) portplan's non-skippable TestDeriveReproducesCommittedEvidence pins the map's bytes to the Java-only derivation pipeline, so an in-map flip would couple the US-003 derived document to the moving Rust tree; (3) assurance/formal/proof-targets.json digest-pins the map's exact bytes (US-006 evidence). The verification therefore lives in the additive overlay evidence/linkage/rust-identity-verification.json, which is what the map's own blocker statement requires ('each Rust identity must be resolver-verified'); flipping the in-map bits would additionally require a US-003 schema/derivation refreeze plus a US-006 proof-targets refreeze under owner authority.

The frozen US-004 lifecycle DAG at assurance/evidence-dag.json was NOT extended: internal/assurance blocks any node drift there ('exact frozen owner-only closure', ROOT_BINDING_MISMATCH). The story/symbol nodes live in the new additive evidence/linkage/evidence-dag.json beside it, with a scope statement disclosing exactly this.
